verdict.rationale: Edit-run loop speed is a fair axis for a JavaScript game framework, but the evidence pack never documents hot reload, live reload, or near-instant preview after a script change. The CLI templates are described only as downloading and configuring packages, with no dev-server or reload behaviour. The Editor's real-time Inspector filter tweaking is visual scene editing, an adjacent feature rather than script-change reload.

support.subject: As a game developer, the edit-run loop is fast — hot reload or near-instant preview after a script change
